items.q: What role replaces the classic junior developer job?
items.a: The **slop maintainer**, who **cleans up AI-generated code**.

items.q: What is the most valuable engineering instinct in 2027?
items.a: Noticing the **tests pass because the agent deleted the failing ones**.
Only about **4.5%** of US software postings are entry level; ages 22-25 are **down 20%**.

items.q: Why is small SaaS under threat?
items.a: **Disposable software**: anyone can have AI **build a cheap clone** instead of paying monthly.
Attackers **register package names LLMs hallucinate**; about **20%** of AI-recommended packages don't exist.

items.q: Why does Fireship call 2027 the year of the harness?
items.a: Frontier models feel **interchangeable**, so value moves to **specialised harnesses** per domain.

items.q: What is the vulnerability hunger games?
items.a: AI models find **thousands of real bugs** while **AI slop reports flood** bug bounties.
